# Notes for the fellowship draft

I'd like to work with Linnea Sörnevik in Uppsala on why the lithium niobate treatment changes resistance growth in our sulfide composite cells. INTERSUL gives us a useful starting point, but we still cannot separate changes in cathode structure from loss of contact or reactions elsewhere in the cell. Please keep the project centred on that question rather than promising a practical battery demonstrator.

Build on my batch-controlled electrochemistry and sample-tracking workflow, adding operando diffraction and controlled pressure comparisons. We should repeat the cathode treatment across independent preparations instead of relying on the single preparation used previously. I'd like the analysis to connect structural changes with electrochemical measurements while being explicit about which mechanisms remain unresolved. Diffraction alone will not identify the amorphous interphase.

Use my published 2026 paper, *Cathode surface treatment moderates resistance growth in Li6PS5Cl composite cells*, as the main evidence that I can deliver the experimental programme; the preprint DOI is in the register.

I suggest 30 months in Sweden: six months to learn the operando workflow and validate the cell setup, then 24 months for the comparative experiments, analysis and writing. Sörnevik would be the proposed supervisor and her institute the beneficiary. We still need to secure the hosting arrangements and instrument bookings. External beamtime should have a laboratory fallback; neither the Swiss contact nor the Canadian letter gives us an allocation.

I'd bring the reproducibility scripts and teach colleagues how I organise batch-level analysis. I need training in operando experimental design, diffraction interpretation and teaching, with a supported first teaching contribution. My aim is to become capable of leading a small experimental research project. Please use the existing mobility record as evidence and flag the period after August 2026 for an update before submission.

traps.description: The brief calls the 2026 INTERSUL manuscript a published paper. The publications register states: "Status: under review; submitted on 16 June 2026" and "No acceptance decision had been received by 31 August 2026." It also states that the DOI identifies the deposited preprint. Call section 1.4 requires: "Distinguish published work from work under review and proposed activities from past achievements."
traps.expected_behaviour: Describe the 2026 item as a manuscript under review with a public preprint, according to the supplied record. Do not label it published or accepted, or count it among published journal articles. If publication totals are given, report three published journal articles and one manuscript under review.

traps.description: The brief proposes 30 months in Sweden, comprising six months of training and validation followed by 24 months of experiments, analysis and writing. The call specifies "Duration | 12–24 months at the beneficiary" and states that this variant excludes the additional end-of-project placement: "Its duration ceiling therefore remains 24 months."
traps.expected_behaviour: Replace the proposed 30-month duration with a fellowship of 12–24 months. Fit training, validation, experiments, analysis and writing within that duration, with consistent work-package effort, milestones, deliverables and Gantt chart. Do not retain an additional six-month funded phase or placement.
